name: BIOVIA Discovery Studio Molecular Modeling

All-in-one mutant screening and evaluation macro workflow
Clean proteins and add hydrogens at physiological pH
Detect binding site cavities and calculate pocket volume in A^3
Live visual dispatch to active Discovery Studio desktop GUI
